description:
Job description

Buscamos profissionais para atuar como parceiro estratégico da área de Operações, com foco em assegurar a gestão eficiente dos custos logísticos, OPEX e CAPEX. Prover análises financeiras robustas, garantir a governança orçamentária e apoiar decisões operacionais através de indicadores financeiros, benchmarks e análises preditivas. Ser um elo entre a estratégia financeira e a execução operacional.


Main responsibilities
  • Consolidar, analisar e projetar os custos logísticos (armazenagem, frete, movimentação, demurrage, etc.), suportando a área operacional na tomada de decisões de curto, médio e longo prazo.
  • Acompanhar e controlar o OPEX operacional, com foco em desvios versus orçamento, eficiência de alocação de recursos e planos de redução de custo.
  • Monitorar e suportar o ciclo de investimentos (CAPEX), desde a aprovação até o encerramento, garantindo visibilidade dos projetos, retorno esperado e correta alocação contábil e gerencial.
  • Participar ativamente dos ciclos de planejamento (Budget, Forecast, LEs), apoiando os times operacionais com dados e análises para definição de metas e simulações financeiras.
  • Desenvolver dashboards e relatórios analíticos que consolidem as visões financeiras para as áreas de Logística, Suprimentos, Operações e Engenharia.
  • Apoiar projetos de automação, eficiência operacional e transformação, contribuindo com análise de viabilidade econômica e financeira.
  • Garantir aderência às políticas contábeis e de capital, atuando como guardião da governança financeira da operação.
  • Atuar de forma transversal com áreas como Custos, Contabilidade, Engenharia, Suprimentos, Planejamento Operacional e TI.
  • Criar e consolidar uma visão gerencial estruturada dos custos logísticos, OPEX e CAPEX, traduzindo a complexidade operacional em indicadores financeiros de performance.
  • Estabelecer governança orçamentária e disciplina financeira junto às áreas operacionais, com foco em acurácia, previsibilidade e melhoria contínua.
  • Implementar metodologias de controle e análise de custos aderentes à realidade da operação, promovendo a cultura de custo como valor estratégico.
  • Garantir sinergia entre a visão financeira e operacional na construção e priorização de projetos de investimento.

Requirements and skills
  • Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, administração, economia ou cursos relacionados;
  • Desejável pós-graduação:
    Finanças, Controladoria e/ou Gestão Empresarial;

Additional information

E tem mais, confira o nosso pacote de benefícios:

- Plano de Saúde e Odontológico – Bradesco – extensivo a dependentes

- PAE - Auxílio financeiro oferecido no caso de dependentes filhos(as) e/ou enteados(as) com deficiência intelectual

- Convênio Farmácia. Descontos de até 70%

- Previdência Complementar – Plano FlexPrev - variando de 1% a 11%, de acordo com o salário

- Seguro de Vida – seguro para todos os colaboradores a partir da data de admissão, sem participação.

- Extensão das Licenças - Maternidade (total de 180 dias) e Paternidade (total de 20 dias).

- Vale-Alimentação e/ou Refeição – Caju Benefícios

- Auxílio-Educação

- Wellhub/Gympass

- Adicional por tempo de serviço – Oferecemos ao colaborador um adicional de salário (de acordo ao tempo de casa) a ser pago por ocasião de férias.

E para o desenvolvimento de nossas equipes...

- Plataforma de Aprendizagem:
Trilha dos valores vibra e curadoria renomada com mais de 200 opções de cursos disponíveis para acesso a qualquer tempo.

- Recrutamento Interno:
Divulgação das vagas disponíveis em todo Brasil, incentivando a mobilidade interna.

The Match Growth & Revenue team is looking for a Quantitative Analyst to join their newly formed Data Science pod. This new position is an exciting opportunity to apply insights and identify wins across our portfolio of brands (including Match, OKCupid, and PlentyOfFish). The role will drive tangible business impact through the analysis of test results and ecosystem trends, collaboration with our Product and Development groups, and quantitative research on how our users find love.

When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for doing our best work so we work together IRL in our Dallas office 2 days/week.


How You'll Make An Impact:

  • Collaborate with other teams, including Product and Development, to shepherd projects from ideation to delivery
  • Propose and design tests for discounting, merchandising, and pricing, with a focus on cross-brand applicability
  • Monitor AB tests, including identifying opportunities for segmentation and iteration, and modelling the long-term ecosystem and revenue impacts.
  • Improve consistency and efficiency of internal querying, reporting, and dashboarding processes.
We Could Be A Match If:
  • You have 3+ years of experience in a role related to business analytics or product analytics
  • You are proficient in SQL (MSSQL and/or Redshift preferred)
  • You are proficient in Microsoft Office and/or Google Drive apps, especially Excel/Sheets
  • You are proficient in statistical software such as R or Python
  • You have a sound understanding of statistics and modelling techniques
  • You have the ability to work collaboratively on a diverse team, featuring colleagues of different backgrounds, specialties, and levels of technical knowledge
  • You have a Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent knowledge) or higher in business, economics, mathematics, quantitative social sciences, statistics, or related field

Why work with us?

Our mission is simple - to help people find love and happiness! We also take great care of our employees.

description:
POSIÇÃO :
Analista Controle de Custos Pleno
A Saipem é líder global na engenharia e construção de grandes projetos para os setores de energia e infraestrutura, tanto offshore como onshore. A Saipem é “Uma Empresa” organizada em cinco linhas de negócios – Serviços Baseados em Ativos, Transportadores de Energia, Energia Eólica Offshore, Infraestruturas Sustentáveis, Robótica e Soluções Industrializadas. A empresa possui 8 estaleiros de fabricação e uma frota offshore de 23 embarcações de construção (das quais 21 próprias e 2 de propriedade de terceiros e administradas pela Saipem) e 15 sondas de perfuração, das quais 8 próprias. Sempre orientada para a inovação tecnológica, o propósito da empresa é “Engenharia para um futuro sustentável”. Como tal, a Saipem está empenhada em apoiar os seus clientes no caminho da transição energética para Net Zero, com meios, tecnologias e processos cada vez mais digitais orientados para a sustentabilidade ambiental. Listada na Bolsa de Valores de Milão, está presente em mais de 50 países ao redor do mundo e emprega cerca de 30 mil pessoas de mais de 120 nacionalidades.
Sempre empenhada em promover e apoiar os valores da diversidade e da inclusão, a Saipem confirma o seu compromisso em valorizar as diferenças como fonte de enriquecimento mútuo. Para tal, promove e incentiva condições que permitam a eliminação de todos os obstáculos que limitem a plena expressão das pessoas e o seu pleno desenvolvimento dentro da organização. Protege e garante condições de trabalho que respeitam a dignidade individual, ao mesmo tempo que promove um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, harmonioso, justo e solidário.
Sobre a Vaga

  • Auxiliar na reorganização do modelo de custos operacionais da Marine Base e Fabricação, considerando custos de operação planejados e extras de cada Projeto;
  • Controlar os todos custos realizados conforme planejamento de cada atividade, subcontratada e Projeto, identificando os savings e deviations de Marine Base e Fabricação por cada JOB/WBS;
  • Desenvolver estudos específicos de análise de custos da base e demais operações relacionadas, impactando o PSR do Projeto;
  • Realizar interface com controladores de custos de projetos offshore e gerentes de Marine Base e Fabricação no CTCO para identificar e justificar os custos existentes do CTCO e preparar a previsão trimestral;
  • Garantir que o Sistema de Controle de Custos funcione de forma eficaz e o status dos custos seja avaliado e relatado de maneira sólida.
  • Emitir o relatório mensal de custos de Marine Base e Fabricação em conjunto com o AFC e no encerramento do ano.
  • Preparar os FORECASTS do canteiro em acordo com prazos e regras do AFC e do PCON;
  • Elaboração do Relatório de encerramento do Projeto e os dados de custo para o Controle de Projetos e Departamentos Comerciais.
Sobre Você
  • Ensino superior em Engenharia de Produção, Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável experiência anterior de trabalho como Cost Controller.
  • Excel Avançado.
  • Inglês Intermediário.

title: Account Coordinator, Remote
description:
At Bluelight, we are searching for a candidate to join our client's team as a direct hire.

At The Missing Ingredient, we are passionate about building a better future through food. Founded nearly a decade ago by CJ Bruce, with the mission to "uncomplicate marketing for the world’s most impactful food and beverage companies." They specialize in partnering with brands that are conscious about creating healthy food and beverage options and sustainable practices. The team of self-professed foodies and digital marketing nerds is dedicated to exceeding results and driving measurable success for the brands they love.

They focus on digital marketing services for natural food & beverage companies as well as nonprofit organizations.

Their core services include paid media, social media, email marketing, and influencer relations.


Role Overview
  • The Account Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting client account management and ensuring seamless internal operations. Reporting to the Account Manager, this individual will assist with client communication, task coordination, and project support across digital marketing campaigns, social media, and administrative activities. The position is remote and requires ability to work 6 hours overlap in the 9-5 PST.
Key Responsibilities
  • Client & Account Support:
  • Support Account Managers in organizing client deliverables and tracking next steps.
  • Join client calls for note-taking and exposure to client communication.
  • Assist in gathering and preparing materials for client meetings and reports.
  • Maintain up-to-date internal documentation to help Account Managers stay aligned.
  • Step in with administrative or coordination support when Account Managers are out.
  • Offer flexible support to meet the evolving needs of the agency.
  • -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  • Project & Task Coordination:
  • Help track project timelines and ensure internal deadlines are documented.
  • Send friendly reminders to team members about upcoming or overdue tasks.
  • Double-check that briefs and resources are shared before tasks begin.
  • Assist in updating task templates and internal workflows under Account Manager guidance.
  • -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  • Team Collaboration & Communication:
  • Meet weekly with Account Managers to understand challenges and support needs.
  • Check in weekly with internal specialists to surface blockers or support needs.
  • Relay specialist feedback to the Account Manager to help inform planning.
  • Coordinate hand-offs between departments (e.G., creative to paid media) to maintain flow.
  • Help facilitate cross-functional collaboration by keeping communication clear and organized.
Success Measurements
  • Client Satisfaction:
    Positive feedback and relationship strength with client accounts.
  • Project Delivery:
    Timeliness and quality of deliverables across campaigns.
  • Internal Coordination:
    Effective communication and collaboration with internal teams.
  • Task Management:
    High on-time task completion rate with minimal oversight.
Required Skills & Experience
  • 2-3 years in account coordination, marketing, project management, social media, or related fields.
  • Previous remote work experience and ability to work 6 hours overlap in the 9-5 PST.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Attention to detail and resourceful problem-solving ability.
  • Adaptability to fast-paced environments and openness to feedback.
  • An strong interest in digital marketing and desire to grow in the marketing industry.
  • Bonus:
    Familiarity with platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, and tools like Teamwork, Notion, Slack, and Google Suite.
  • Bonus:
    Experience in copywriting, content creation, or influencer marketing.
Career Growth & Advancement
  • Potential progression into Account Manager and Senior Account Manager roles based on performance.
  • Opportunities to specialize in client strategy, campaign leadership, or team management with demonstrated proficiency and leadership skills.
Security & Compliance Requirements
  • Adherence to internal confidentiality policies and client-specific data handling requirements.
Reporting & Team Structure
  • Reports directly to the Account Manager.
  • Collaborates cross-functionally with creative, paid media, and influencer marketing teams.
  • No supervisory responsibilities initially but expected to manage tasks and project timelines independently.
Additional Expectations
  • Active participation in weekly team meetings, training sessions, and ongoing process improvements.
  • Contribution to a positive, solution-oriented team culture.
  • Commitment to professional development and continuous learning in digital marketing trends.
Compensation Structure
  • The compensation philosophy ensures competitive pay aligned with performance, proficiency, and company affordability. Compensation is reviewed annually based on market benchmarks and individual contributions.
  • Location:
    Remote
  • Employment Type:
    Full-Time
What The Missing Ingredient Offers
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Flexible paid vacation. (You are responsible for ensuring coverage while out)
  • Annual end-of-year profit sharing based on salary, tenure, and performance. Dependent on agency profitability at at the discretion of agency ownership.
  • Guaranteed minimum 3% salary increase YoY, with additional increases based on performance.
  • Ongoing education paid by The Missing Ingredient (courses, books, conferences, etc.), up to $500/year.
  • Opportunities for professional growth across various digital marketing disciplines.
  • Dynamic, collaborative, and mission-driven team culture.

If you are interested please apply.

description:
Pacifica Continentalis an international recruitment consultancy that provides different services focused on talents to impact companies’ business all over the world. We provide a young and dynamic environment and by being result-oriented our main goal is to delivery outstanding solutions for all of our clients.

Our customized solutions and consultative approach ensure we select the best talent in the market and our operations have reached over 50 countries, including more than 250 cities around the world.

We pride ourselves on working with precision and expertise in a wide range of industries!


Our DNA

Ambition - We are guided by excellence, we push for progress and not perfection.

Connection - We believe that people are the real drive of our company.

About Atacadão

O Atacadão é a única rede atacadista alimentar presente em todos os estados do Brasil, com 415 pontos de operação, sendo 379 lojas de autosserviço e 36 atacados de entrega e centros de distribuição, que juntos alcançam 95% dos 5.570 municípios do país.
Somos um dos maiores empregadores do país, com 76 mil colaboradores e colaboradoras que trabalham diariamente pela missão de oferecer alimentos de qualidade a preços justos para o abastecimento de comerciantes, transformadores e consumidores finais.
Com infraestrutura moderna e eficiente, o Atacadão disponibiliza aos seus clientes uma variada gama de produtos, com cerca de 10 mil itens, nas categorias de laticínios, hortifrúti, bebidas, doces e biscoitos, higiene pessoal, limpeza, bazar, produtos da linha pet, automotivo, entre outros, além de serviços como padaria, açougue e frios e fatiados.
O Atacadão marca presença no ambiente digital por meio do seu e-commerce, com um próprio canal de vendas online mais direcionado a transformadores, comerciantes e empreendedores de pequenas, médias e grandes empresas, pela possibilidade de adquirir volumes maiores de itens, parcerias com aplicativos de entrega que atendem ao consumidor final, e também o Meu Atacadão, aplicativo que permite que os clientes encontrem ofertas diferenciadas enquanto fazem suas compras nas lojas físicas.
Tem como pilares de sustentabilidade o combate à fome e às desigualdades, a diversidade e inclusão e a proteção ao planeta & biodiversidade.

Esta rede é direcionada a pessoas plenos e sêniores que buscam atuar como Investor na XP Inc na região Sudeste. O Investor ocupa a posição de referência técnica para o segmento e, além de garantir a qualidade na alocação dos clientes, atua sendo interface direta com as áreas de negócio da companhia, pensando estrategicamente quais ativos devem ser trabalhados e quais perfis de cliente têm maior propensão para determinada oferta. Geram insumos comerciais para todo o time, através de treinamentos, dados, materiais, etc.

  • Atender os principais clientes da XP, em conjunto com o Banker do cliente;
  • Ser referência técnica sobre produtos, planejamento financeiro e asset allocation no segmento;
  • Identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos, garantindo assertividade comercial;

  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade;
  • Atuar no nível tático e estratégico junto as áreas que impactam direta e indiretamente o cliente final.
  • Sólido conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RV, RF, Fundos, Previdência, entre outros);
  • Conhecimento sobre asset alllocation, enquadramento, inteligência de base;

    maternidade de 6 meses e paternidade de 20 dias.

Vida Financeira

  • Assessoria de Investimentos

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes.
Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.

A Baker Hughes, líder no setor de serviços de campos petrolíferos, oferece oportunidades para pessoas qualificadas que desejam crescer em nossa organização de alto desempenho. Nossas tecnologias líderes e nossa capacidade de aplicá-las com segurança criam valor de forma eficaz para nossos clientes e acionistas.

Como Mandrilhador I, você será responsável por:
Tarefas Diárias
  • Realizar reunião de pré-trabalho, preenchendo formulários e checklists, lendo procedimentos e documentos para identificar se os itens necessários para a atividade estão disponíveis.
  • Movimentar peças para a máquina usando ponte rolante, talha, cintas, olhais, correntes e manilhas, seguindo procedimentos de segurança e isolando a área.
  • Preparar a peça na máquina, fixando-a na mesa da mandrilhadora conforme informações da Engenharia Industrial, garantindo que não se mova durante a usinagem.
  • Isolar a área de trabalho seguindo procedimentos de segurança.
  • Capturar os pontos zeros usando relógios apalpadores, comparadores ou cabeça Probe, para garantir o alinhamento do programa CNC com a peça.
  • Zerar as ferramentas manualmente, usando blocos padrão ou encostando na peça, inserindo os valores na máquina para definir o ponto zero.
  • Operar mandrilhadoras Wotans para usinagem, incluindo fresamento, furação, rosqueamento e usinagem de perfis internos, conforme o programa CNC.
  • Realizar inspeções dimensionais usando instrumentos de medição, garantindo que as peças estejam dentro das especificações do projeto.
  • Usar cabeçotes angulares na usinagem, fixando-os na máquina para operações em ângulos específicos.
Requisitos para ter sucesso na função:
  • Ensino médio completo
  • Curso de Fresador CNC
  • Experiência prévia na função
  • Controle dimensional
  • Leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos
  • Conhecimentos em Métodos e Processos de Usinagem
  • Capacidade de identificar e registrar questões de segurança
  • Sugerir melhorias nos processos
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos
  • Conhecimentos em GD&T (Tolerâncias Geométricas)
Características desejadas:
  • Manuseio de ponte rolante
  • Conhecimentos em softwares como Oracle, Epims, Gensuite, Manusis
  • Conhecimento em ferramental e consumíveis
  • Treinamento LEAN Básico
  • Programação CNC
  • Cursos na área de Metalurgia
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas
  • Conhecimento em Produto de Óleo e Gás
  • Inglês intermediário
Benefícios e cultura da empresa:

Valorizamos a diversidade e oferecemos políticas de equilíbrio entre vida profissional e pessoal, assistência médica privada, seguros de vida, programas de invalidez, benefícios financeiros e outros benefícios adicionais.

Sobre a Baker Hughes:

Operamos em mais de 120 países, comprometidos com a inovação e sustentabilidade, incluindo a meta de atingir zero emissões líquidas de carbono até 2050. Valorizamos pessoas apaixonadas por tornar a energia mais segura, limpa e eficiente.

Junte-se a nós:

Se deseja fazer a diferença em uma empresa global, venha crescer conosco. Oferecemos oportunidades iguais para todos, incluindo pessoas com deficiência. Nossas decisões de contratação são baseadas em mérito, sem discriminação por raça, cor, religião, origem, gênero, idade ou deficiência.

description:
Company Description

At Turner & Townsend we’re passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people to realize their potential, and doing our part to create a prosperous society.

Every day we help our major global clients deliver ambitious and highly technical projects in over 118 offices in 50 countries worldwide.

Our team is dynamic, innovative and client focused. Our clients value our proactive approach, depth of expertise, integrity and the quality we deliver. As a result, our people get to work on some of the most exciting projects in the world.

Job Description

The Planning Engineer will take responsibility for effectively delivering a range of tasks to high quality standard and aid on a wide range of projects of all sizes and dimensions.

Handles commissions of varying sizes, depending upon the complexity of the project. Can work as part of a larger team or as the key day-to-day contact point with the client.

Help to set up the overall success criteria for the project, including time, cost, technical and performance parameter, project governance, project planning, processes, and systems to be used throughout project.

Candidates should preferably have experience in the Oil and Gas sector with knowledge of all aspects of a project such as Civil-Structural and Electro-Mechanical Engineering.

Responsibilities

Included but not limited to:

  • Collaboration with key stakeholders for accurate and timely updates on the projects engineering, procurement, and construction phases, will be key to the project’s success.
  • Prepare and maintain the project Basis of Schedule
  • Establish and manage the project master schedule for the engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning phases.
  • Apply resource loading for establishing optimal crew/staffing plans.
  • Calculate and manage Earned Value KPIS and progress tracking with S curves.
  • Learn and implement the scheduling specifications of the owner.
  • Coordinate the project progress tracking with the GC in all the stages of the value chain.
  • Ensure the project schedule activities are coded by the project work breakdown structure and interface to the controls systems for progress / forecast updates and analysis.
  • Establish the project critical path and continue to analyze and report throughout the project.
  • Incorporate any required scope changes and trends into project schedule.
  • Analysis of impacts and deviations and proposition of mitigation measures
  • Provide client and internal weekly, bi-weekly/monthly reporting inputs of plan vs actual and any forecast mitigation strategies.
  • Comply with relevant Owner policies and procedures and work within legal and regulatory frameworks.
Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Architecture or related.
  • A minimum of 7 years of related experience.
  • Advanced experience with the MS Office Package (Project, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) and Primavera P6.
  • Fluent in English.

title: Clinical Project Manager
description:
As the primary sponsor liaison and advocate, the Clinical Project Manager will plan, execute, manage and monitor regional, single modality or therapeutic area clinical research projects. Utilizing existing templates, processes and programs as a guide, he or she will adapt/develop, implement, monitor and be accountable for project protocols, operational plans, risk management, resources, project tools/materials, documents and timelines. The successful candidate will be managing the day to day activities and performance of a multidisciplinary project team, ensuring all decisions align with corporate, industry, sponsor and regulatory requirements.


Project Management
  • Manage the planning, execution, progress and completion of assigned clinical research projects.
  • Work with functional experts to ensure all project activities comply with applicable regulations, guidelines, and corporate policies.
  • Maintain operational, financial and regulatory integrity and safety.
  • Develop and/or participate in the development of project communications, training, regulatory submissions and/or audits and selection of third party vendors as required.
Documents and Tools
  • Manage a cross-functional team to ensure the appropriate creation, delivery, maintenance and disposal of all related data, documents, equipment and tools, including protocols, SOPs, informed consent forms, case report forms and instructions.
  • Prepare investigator updates and other project related reports as required to support the proper conduct and execution throughout the life cycle of assigned projects.
Project Team Performance
  • Identify, assign and monitor the completion of interdisciplinary project tasks that include site monitoring, CRF and database development and revision, data collection, patient safety/adverse event management, document management, statistical analysis and/or final report writing and publications.
  • Ensure task completion performance meets or exceeds quality standards and sponsor/client, project and regulatory expectations and guidelines.
Client/Sponsor Support
  • Act as primary liaison throughout the project life cycle ensuring client/sponsor expectations are appropriately managed by addressing and resolving queries/issues, planning and executing all project meetings, assisting with site and patient recruitment strategies and materials, assisting with the development of stakeholder training and by regularly providing sponsor/client with project status and update reports.
Qualifications
  • Applicants should have a minimum of one to three years of related work experience with ongoing training, and a three-year College Advance Diploma/Degree in a relevant field of study, preferable in (Health) Sciences or Clinical Research.
  • The successful candidate must exhibit the following skills:
    self-motivation with strong communication skills and a commitment to achieving positive results.
  • Strong attention to detail and keenness to understand the importance of building collaborative relationships to achieve results.
  • Ability to engage in continuous learning and self-development.
  • Ability to continually foster teamwork.
  • Fluent in reading, writing, and speaking of English
Working Conditions
  • Home Based

Presente em mais de 25 países , conectando pessoas, oportunidades, projetos e negócios globalmente. Criamos e transformamos conhecimento em resultados.

Additional information

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :
)

Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica:

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

RINA Brasil is seeking an Energy Engineering Project Manager for our Rio de Janeiro offices within the Energy Engineering Project Management Division.

Mission

The Engineering Project Manager oversees the execution of engineering projects at RINA, ensuring quality standards, meeting deadlines, and delivering results aligned with client needs and company policies.   • Develop and maintain detailed project plans using tools like Microsoft Project and Excel, tracking progress and identifying risks.

Job description

#VemSerMAG

Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar de lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar! Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a Great Place to Work.

Somos uma empresa PLURAL!

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito e valores

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos:
Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros . Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona:
temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.

Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.

  • Experiência na elaboração de materiais e aplicação de treinamento e plataformas de LMS/LXP;

  • Perfil autônomo, pragmático, com agilidade na execução e foco em entregas de qualidade;

  • Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida, presencialmente de 4 a 8 vezes por mês no Centro do Rio de Janeiro. Caso seja colaborador(a) da MAG e resida fora do Rio, a atuação deverá ocorrer em unidade da MAG mais próxima à residência, na mesma frequência.

PRODUCTION TECHNICIAN LEAD

Reports To:
 Production Supervisor

Background:

The Production Technician Lead must show a strong safety behavior (safety culture disseminator) and will be able to lead daily operations such as operating plant processes and utility systems effectively.
They will ensure all procedures will always be followed and that O&M Contractor and local regulatory compliance are met in all aspects of work.
The Production Technician Lead will facilitate routine maintenance by isolations and reinstatement, liaising with CRO/Production Supervisor.
They act as a technical leader to all production technicians using their seniority, experience and knowledge.
They can delegate work and responsibilities to the Instrument Technicians they lead during the execution of their routines.
They act as Instrument Technician when required by workload.

Authority:

The Production Technician Lead assumes responsibility of the production technicians assigned to the system being its expertise and is authorized to operate the process and utility systems safely and efficiently. Immediate

Subordinates:

Production Technicians, Subcontractors, Visitors, Vendors, external and unplanned or temporary services.

Accountable For:
Typical Responsibilities & Standards

1) Process
Start up, Operate, Monitor and Shut Down Process and Utility systems.
Monitor, maintain, and optimize process parameters (Level, flow, temperature, pressure, etc.) within operating requirements.
Ensure sampling is carried out and sample results are acted upon.
Troubleshoot to maximize sales quality and delivery volume to identify problems.
Maintain discharge water quality within current GEMS or local guidelines.
Monitor and operate electrical/hydraulic control panels, safety and emergency shutdown devices, and Fire and Gas Systems.
Ensure accurate and timely production reporting and logging is submitted daily or as required by the company.
Witness third-party calibrations when appropriate to provide verification of meter factors and volumes.
Prove export oil meters.
Coaching less experienced Productions technicians.

2) Marine/Safety
Work to Management System policies and procedures, particularly Isolation Standards, and PTW.
Carry out all operations in a safe and environmentally sound manner.
Report all discharges, leaks, spills, injuries, and incidents, immediately.
Ensure vendor and subcontract personnel within responsibility understand and comply with current environmental regulations.
Carry out Emergency Response role.

3) Maintenance
Facilitate maintenance operations by supervising, coordinating, and applying/removing isolations as required.
Operation under PTW system, Toolbox Talk, and Risk Assessments.
Advise maintenance personnel on hazards of plant and equipment.
Facilitate maintenance operations related to preservation when required.
Maintain clear and precise communications during maintenance operations.

4) Manage & Supervise Effectively
Control activities of vendor and subcontractor personnel.
Create and maintain effective working relationships.
Create and maintain positive work culture.
Act as a leader with the team.

5) Management System
Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.
Promote safety awareness and application of company Management systems, COPs, and prime policies.
Work together with Production Supervisor on WO´s PM`s to plan for operations.
Ensure production technician apply all safety procedures correctly in the workplace.
Manages SBM reports, Permit Work system, and CMMS system. Navigate through the system, open/close WO´s.
Ensure contractors apply all safety procedures correctly in the workplace.

6) Emergency Response
Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience:


Proven experience and/or qualified to N/SVQ Hydrocarbon Processing Level 2 or similar qualification level from country of origin.
Experience in hydrocarbon processing systems and utilities.
Knowledge of ESD F&G and DCS operation.
Good understanding of Electronic Permit to Work, IFS, Mechanical Isolation Standards, and Risk Assessment.
Proficiency in English at a minimum of A2 level according to the CEFR international standard.
Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group (“the Company”). For further information, please visit our website at The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.

  • Promover/participar de reuniões com outros departamentos (Atendimento ao Cliente, Manutenção, Auditoria, Postos e Bases, Comercial, Merchandising) conforme agendamento mensal, semanal ou de urgência específica, para alinhamento de andamento de processos, troca de ideias, resolução de problemas e definição de planos de ação.

title: Strategic Operations Analyst
description:
Job Post:
Strategic Operations Analyst

Full-Time | Associate / Analyst Level

Department:
Strategic Solutions

About the Role:

We are looking for a Strategic Operations Analyst to join our Strategic Solutions Department. This role is key to driving internal efficiency, strengthening data integrity, and enhancing cross-departmental collaboration. You’ll act as a strategic enabler and systems observer, ensuring that our CRM/PRM tools are used effectively to generate insights and support long-term planning.

If you are analytical, process-minded, and proactive in maintaining high-quality internal data, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Intelligence & PRM/CRM Oversight

  • Monitor CRM/PRM data to detect gaps in client engagement history.
  • Follow up with Sales Directors and team members to ensure accurate data logging.
  • Analyze CRM/PRM data to identify trends, support reporting, and generate strategic insights.

Cross-Functional Process Understanding

  • Map and document workflows across departments.
  • Observe meetings and shadow teams to identify silos and inefficiencies.
  • Recommend improvements to drive clarity, redundancy, or cross-training.

Strategic Support & Insights

  • Support leadership with initiatives like client segmentation, performance reviews, and market analysis.
  • Extract and present data for strategic decision-making.
  • Maintain a log of observations, bottlenecks, and actionable suggestions.

Documentation & Reporting

  • Keep SOPs and internal process documents up-to-date.
  • Deliver recurring summaries with data quality status, key insights, and recommendations.
  • Contribute to quarterly presentations and strategic overviews.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 1–3 years of experience in business analysis, sales operations, or internal consulting.
  • Fluent in English
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • Excellent communication and follow-up skills—especially with senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to navigate cross-functional environments and competing priorities.
  • Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint;
    BI tools a plus.

The Position

The overall purpose of the Insurance Manager is to ensure the efficient implementation and supervision of the insurance coverage according to FIFA requirements. He will also be the local contact person to the local Insurance Brokers.All tasks listed below shall be conducted in close collaboration with the FIFA Insurance Lead, and where needed with the FIFA Audit, Risk & Advisory subdivision.Key Responsibilities
  • Implement and monitor an appropriate local insurance solution (Personal Insurances, Property Damage and Business Interruption Insurances, Marine Cargo & Liability Insurances (e.G. General Liability incl. Medical Malpractice, D&O, Error & Omissions, Motor Liability etc.)) for all FWWC 2027 entities.
  • Monitor and advice the Host Cities, Stadium Owners, Training Site Owners in regards to the insurance requirements and make sure that all is implemented in time.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Procurement teams in order to make sure that all legal contracts, which the FWWC 2027 entities will enter with sponsors, suppliers and event contractors for services required to deliver FIFA Woman World Cup 2027, have the required adequate and appropriate insurance clauses, indemnities and warranties in place.

  • Being the insurance interface for the local FWWC 2027 entities for all internal and external stakeholders.
  • Identification and evaluation of potential risks and proposal of countermeasures.
  • Being part and support the implementation of a local risk management program for the FIFA Woman World Cup 2027 entities.
  • Regular organization of insurance surveys.

Your profile

  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in the insurance and risk sector.
  • Solid experience in the areas of insurance on the local Brazil markets as well as experience in risk management, insurance and contract drafting
  • Strong knowledge of the insurance laws in the Brazil. Understanding of which conditions are usual “good local standard” in Brazil.
  • Good familiarity with the market players and experience in negotiations with the local insurers
  • Proven record of accomplishment in internal risk management and insurance issues settlement (especially on local mandatory insurances and employee benefits) and understanding of how high a deductible should be set etc.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
  • Spanish and/or German is a plus if spoken and written
  • Advanced skills in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project)
  • Planning software and online collaboration tools (an asset)

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Senior Cost Controller
description:
The Cost Optimization team is responsible for identifying cost reduction opportunities within Brazil Operations without compromising safety or service quality.

Brazil Operations is a critical business unit for SBM Offshore’s cash flow, handling 20-30% of Brazil’s oil production.

The cost structure of Brazil Operations is heavily focused on maintenance activities that ensure FPSOs (Floating Production Storage and Offloading units) can operate for up to 25 years in remote ocean locations, ensuring equipment reliability and the integrity of hulls and tanks.

The Senior Cost Controller will be a key player in this strategic initiative, requiring a blend of strategic vision and strong skills in modeling and data analysis.

RESPONSIBILITIES
  1. Understand the cost structure of Brazil Operations to identify areas of high expenditure within the P&L.
  2. Identify and prioritize cost-reduction opportunities by assessing financial feasibility (business cases), developing projections/forecasts, and maximizing returns.
  3. Lead or collaborate on cost-reduction projects with internal teams (e.G., Supply Chain, HR, Maintenance), providing critical analysis of both cost and performance data that impacts costs (e.G., productivity). This includes defining key performance indicators (KPIs), data gathering, insights generation, proposing improvements, and influencing business transformation.
  4. Improve cost tracking processes by generating regular optimization reports using internal systems (e.G., ERP). Take responsibility for data from source to transformation, including dashboard creation and data flow automation. Ensure data consistency, quality, and governance, collaborating with IT.
  5. Support communication initiatives to raise awareness among employees about the importance of cost management, linking it to the company’s long-term strategy.
REQUIREMENTS
  1. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Economics, Accounting, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related fields.
  2. An MBA or a master’s degree in finance is highly desirable.
  3. Solid experience in consulting, cost optimization, cost analysis, financial efficiency, corporate finance, financial modeling, project valuation, strategic planning, data intelligence, data analytics, business intelligence, or process optimization.
  4. Fluent in both Portuguese and English (written and spoken).
  5. Experience with databases modeling tools (e.G., Access, Alteryx, Power Pivot/Power Query, ETL, Star Schema, OLAP, master data management, cubes, or similar), managing large datasets.
  6. Basic knowledge in the following (no professional experience required):
    SQL or any programming language.
  7. Project valuation and business cases (e.G., ROI, NPV).
  8. Key financial reports (balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow).
  9. Basic knowledge of the Oil and Gas industry is desirable.
  10. Familiarity with Maintenance Strategy and Integrity concepts is a plus.
